output.reason: The proposed exposure can't be evaluated. It treats "helm" and "kubectl apply" as container CLI flags, uses a CustomResourceDefinition GVK check with no group, and adds an undecidable leaf for something configuration can show. The section context names the setting behind this change: [ev-fa194382072a] says CRD templating in the base chart is now on by default through `base.enableCRDTemplates`, which now defaults to true, and setting it to false restores the old behaviour. [ev-85eccdc718e3] and [ev-2941a875a468] describe the same change: templated CRDs that can be upgraded with `helm upgrade istio-base`, with changed CRD labels. This is the canonical shape for a changed Helm default: environments that leave the key unset are exposed, and environments that set it explicitly are shielded.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24 base chart templates CRDs by default (base.enableCRDTemplates now defaults to true), so CRDs can be upgraded via helm upgrade istio-base and their labels change to Helm-style labels; environments that leave base.enableCRDTemplates unset get the new behavior, those setting it explicitly keep their chosen behavior.
